# Adsun Task Ad Wall Demo

> Task custom element with visible completion and no-inventory states.

## Canonical sources
- [README](https://github.com/Adsuner/adsun-task-wall-demo/blob/main/README.md): setup, scope and limitations.
- [Official Adsun documentation](https://adsun.io/documentation/publisher/api-reference): upstream API/workflow reference.

## Boundaries
Independent teaching example, not proprietary SDK source. No credentials or environment files. Browser SDK is loaded only from https://api.adsun.io/sdk.js. No guarantee of search or AI indexing.
